generate_difference_report: generate a difference report between two benchmark JSON runs showing time and CPU changes
calculate_change: calculate the decimal change between an old value and a new value
color_format: format a string with optional ANSI color codes that can be disabled
find_longest_name: find the length of the longest benchmark name in a list of benchmark objects
review_BenchmarkColor: review the BenchmarkColor class and its ANSI color code constants for terminal output
